content.description: Tribe Capital is a San Francisco-based venture capital firm founded in 2018. The firm participates in seed, early, and late-stage rounds, maintaining a broad investment scope across technology-enabled sectors. It backs companies in software as a service (SaaS), cybersecurity, digital health, e-commerce, fintech, and blockchain technology, illustrating its sustained interest in scalable software and digital platforms across multiple markets.
